description: Aquifer Storage and Recovery: A Strategy for Long-Term Water Security in Puerto Rico is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Puerto Rico Agency for Emergency Management and Disaster Administration; GLM Engineering COOP; Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources. A unique, relatively low-cost project can serve as a model for long-term water security strategies across the Caribbean. Coverage: the United States (2018). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
